H5b.targets: pooled (video and URLLC-like target, mean per evaluation window)
H5b.reference: alpha = 1 arm of the same date and pipeline (D5)
H5b.unit: credits per interval (distorting tenant, evaluation windows)
H5b.test: two-sided p (Holm); support needs the pre-registered side

dev_estimation_half.method: (a) analytic: G = ((r z_{1-a} + z_{0.8}) sd / delta)^2, r = SE of the two-stage bootstrap / (sd / sqrt(G_est)); (b) simulation: estimation-half dates resampled to G with the registered two-stage bootstrap, rule and Holm alpha/4
dev_estimation_half.note: TEST dates for 80 % power of the registered test (two-stage date bootstrap, rule, Holm alpha/4; two-sided, alpha/8 per side, pre-registered sign); DEV has 4 windows per date, TEST 8 (E1-E4) or the same 4 (E5)

simulation.note: rejection share of the rule and Holm's first step (alpha/4) among simulated experiments

dev_estimation_half.decision_basis: simulated power at G = 16 and the CI bound nearest the null (PREREG §9.4); 24 when below 80%

seed_spread.note: descriptive; the H5b estimate averages the seeds within a window

net.definition: per date: later gain + attack change x (attack windows / evaluation windows); date bootstrap (one value per date)

notes: EfiveDiffMeas/EfiveDiffStored: no E5 episode tables (E5 without --keep-episodes); EfiveDiffParams reports the stored-report parameter differences instead
